summary: Iteration 6 covered the new Signup Bonus Protection System end-to-end. BACKEND: /app/backend/tests/test_bonus_protection.py (8 tests, 8 PASS). Coverage: (a) GET /api/bonus/status public (settings enabled/bonusAmount/requireFirstPurchase/minPurchaseAmount present); (b) admin GET+PUT /api/admin/bonus/settings — updates persist (bonusAmount=15, minPurchaseAmount=25); non-admin PUT -> 403; (c) authz — non-admin GET /admin/bonus/{settings,history,user-status,suspicious-users} and POST /admin/bonus/review all -> 403; (d) email-verification gate — pre-verify /bonus/evaluate returns eligible=false, status=pending_email_verification; POST /bonus/verify-email evaluates and credits $15 to wallet, /auth/me reflects walletBalance>=15; (e) one-device fraud — second user reusing same deviceId gets status=pending_review, isSuspicious=true, reason mentions Device; (f) duplicate phone — second user with shared phone gets flagged with 'Phone' reason; (g) disposable email (@tempmail.com) — flagged with 'Disposable/temporary' reason; (h) admin triage — GET /admin/bonus/history returns records list, /user-status returns list, /suspicious-users returns list; POST /admin/bonus/review action=approve on a pending_review record -> {ok:true, record.status='credited'}. FRONTEND (real browser, admin login on preview URL): /admin/console?tab=bonus loads BonusProtectionSection. All 4 metric cards visible (status=Active, amount=$15, first-purchase-gate=None, suspicious=13 with ACTION badge). Settings form editable — set bonusAmount=15 and minPurchaseAmount=25, save, page reload verified persistence. All 4 sub-tabs (settings/history/users/suspicious) navigate and render their views. Suspicious list shows 13 flagged users with Approve/Reject/Clear-Suspicion buttons (data-testid approve-bonus-<uid>, reject-bonus-<uid>, clear-suspicious-<uid>). Fraud reasons rendered per card (duplicate phone, device fingerprint reuse). No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1682 lines and includes auth, catalog, orders, payments, receipts, SMS, admin, wallet, gateways, and now the entire bonus router (~350 lines). Overdue for router-split (routers/bonus.py, wallet.py, payments.py, sms.py).

bonus_protection.evaluate_fraud_and_bonus writes user.suspiciousReasons and marks isSuspicious=True even before the account has actually attempted to redeem; safe today but risks user visibility if any UI surfaces isSuspicious to end users — currently only admin console reads it, so acceptable.

IP-based duplicate detection ignores 127.0.0.1/localhost by design, which means all local dev / preview traffic behind the ingress ALWAYS shows ipAddress=127.0.0.1 and therefore the IP-duplicate rule never triggers in this environment; in production make sure request.headers['x-forwarded-for'] first hop is captured by _extract_client_meta (verify implementation).
AdminConsole.jsx now 759 lines — same recommendation as iteration 5: split each tab into components/admin/*.jsx.

BonusProtectionSection.jsx save endpoint sends the entire settings object (including derived fields updatedAt/updatedBy); backend ignores unknowns via explicit key allowlist in bonus_protection.update_settings — good defensive coding. Consider stripping client-side to reduce payload noise.

Public /api/bonus/status returns settings.requireVerifiedPhone/oneBonusPerDevice/detectDuplicateAccounts too — these are effectively admin-only policy toggles being exposed publicly. Consider whitelisting only enabled/bonusAmount/requireFirstPurchase/minPurchaseAmount for the anonymous caller.
